test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 10 numbers is 37. If each number is decreased by 2, what will be the new average?
solution:
Concept:

 When each number is decreased by "n" then the average will also be decreased by "n".

Calculation:

New average = 37 - 2 = **35**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__When each number is increased by "n" then the average will also be increased by "n".

When each number is multiplied by "n" then the average will also be multiplied by "n".

When each number is divided by "n" then the average will also be divided by "n".
